name: Black Beach
source:
Yamato Jin, the president of the Yamato Consortium, invites his girlfriend Natsukawa Erika to an unpopulated resort island that he was left in charge of by his father. He intends to spend some time alone with her in this artificial paradise. Erika doesn't hesitate to accept his invitation. The island is supposed to be empty, except for the both of them... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032908.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
大和财团的总裁大和仁邀请女友夏川绘里香前往父亲交给自己管理的一座无人度假岛。他打算与她在这座人工天堂里独处一段时间。绘里香毫不犹豫地接受了邀请。岛上本应空无一人，除了他们两人……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032908.html]DLsite English[/url]]
